FN-ZEFJWK-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 378
Committee: Economic Development and Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Tourism
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/02/2023
House Bill 378 as introduced would allow the Alabama Department of Environmental
Management (ADEM) to assess a $500 per acre Brownfield Remediation Reserve Fund
Contribution on certain properties, which would be deposited into the non-reverting Brownfield
Remediation Reserve Fund, created by this bill. This bill would provide that: (1) this fund would
be administered by ADEM to fund certain remediation or post-remediation costs, up to $4
million per property, and (2) monies in this fund may be invested pursuant to state law.
